title: London office blocked from Teams
scenario: Chat-style exchange: a new VPN egress range makes a sign-in risk policy block the London office; DNS and proxies are ruled out, an exclusion aimed at the wrong group changes nothing, and adding the contractors group fixes it.

events.title: teams blocking ppl
events.text: hi. teams keeps blocking ppl at our london office, msg says something like access blocked contact ur admin. since this morning approx 25 users. ive tried restarting the app and the pc, nothing

events.title: Re: teams blocking ppl
events.text: hi, sorry about that. can u send 3 users + a utc time for a failed login for each, and the exact text on the screen?

events.title: Re: teams blocking ppl
events.text: ok. j.smith 08:12, a.patel 08:20, m.okafor 08:31 (thats local, we are UTC+1 so 07:12 etc sorry). text: You cannot access this right now. Your sign-in was successful but does not meet the criteria to access this resource.

events.title: Re: teams blocking ppl
events.text: thx. looking at the logs now, back in 10

events.text:

07:20:41Z a.patel    ResultType 53003  Blocked by Conditional Access  Policy: Block risky sign-ins  RiskLevelDuringSignIn: medium  IP 203.0.113.51

events.title: Re: teams blocking ppl
events.text: found it: the CA policy Block risky sign-ins is blocking them, risk = medium (unfamiliar sign-in properties). has anything changed on ur side re ip / vpn / egress lately? it usually happens when the sign-in ip changes

events.title: Re: teams blocking ppl
events.text: yes!! we moved to a new vpn provider last wed so everybody now exits from a new ip range 203.0.113.0/24. is that the thing?? btw is there any news on the teams rooms firmware, someone asked me

events.title: dns and proxy checks from the london vpn
events.text: likely yes. to rule out the usual suspects i tested from the london vpn: all 3 resolvers (10.50.0.2, .3, .4) answer the sign-in hosts fine, and all 4 proxy nodes respond normally. so its not dns or proxy, its the CA risk policy reacting to the new ip range

events.title: Re: teams blocking ppl
events.text: pls ask ur identity team to (1) add the new vpn ranges as a trusted named location or (2) exclude the london group from the risk policy while they review it. if u do (2) tell me the time so i can check the logs. (re rooms firmware: not my area, ask the devices team)

events.title: Re: teams blocking ppl
events.text: excluded the london-staff group from Block risky sign-ins at 10:05 utc. people still blocked :( one just refreshed and got the same msg

events.title: logs after 10:05
events.text: yes: the exclusion is on the group London Staff, but the 3 users are in London Contractors, which is not excluded. their new rows still show the policy applied and blocked

events.title: Re: teams blocking ppl
events.text: oh!! added the contractors group too, 10:40 utc. testing with the 3 of them now

events.title: Re: teams blocking ppl
events.text: all 3 can sign in now. others in london say the same

events.title: check after the second exclusion
events.text: confirmed: from 10:40 utc no CA blocks for london users in the logs (checked 25 mins, 118 sign-ins). pls fix it properly with the trusted ranges. closing after ur ok
